text: Program Description The duration of study is generally 1 year. You can join the Chinese Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK for short) and get the Chinese Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi certificate. Through long-term and short-term Chinese language training, you can improve your Chinese application ability in different degrees, deepen your understanding of Chinese language, culture and current situation, and become a high-quality applied talent who can meet the needs of the international community and Chinese proficiency. Main Courses: Chinese Comprehensive Course, Chinese Speaking, Chinese Listening, Chinese Reading and Writing, Chinese traditional culture experience activities (Chinese calligraphy and painting, carving, traditional festivals, etc.). Note: In September 2025, SPPC will move to the new campus. At that time, all students enrolling will be required to live in the on-campus dormitories.
